research_notes: Initial review 2026-10-01: frozen official occupation list supplemented by employer statement, primary personal/party accounts, public professional profile and reliable reporting. No roster refresh. Childcare and insurance jobs omitted from frozen occupation list explicitly preserved as unresolved spells.

Retail dates are month-precision self-report, not verified payroll. The Drakes employer account of Yankalilla opening in 2022 raises a predecessor/operator question for 2018–2022. Do not claim continuous employment by a particular Drakes legal entity until reconciled.

Searches of exact profile, Health Partners and childcare did not independently confirm employer names or precise additional dates. An unsolicited contact-aggregator result suggests Health Partners customer experience December 2023–June 2024, but it was not opened and that lead is not promoted to a factual spell. Follow public primary profile or employer evidence next; do not gather contact details. UK childcare-manager namesakes excluded.

Full-time evidence absent. Casual retail work remains unknown in approved enum; political staff part-time rests on secondary reporting. Student and volunteer overlaps preclude automatic continuous full-time assumptions. Union/party/study/elected office excluded; no zero inferred for public or private employment.

Follow-up: childcare identity/duties/dates/control, insurance legal employer and nonprofit status, retail predecessor/contract/hours, MP and union exact dates and leave, Young Labor end and remuneration. Last follow-up 2026-10-01. Next initial member Penny Wong.
